questions.q: What does a Gaussian splat store that a coloured point doesn't?
options: A size in three directions, a rotation and an opacity
questions.answer: A size in three directions, a rotation and an opacity
questions.why: SPLAT has scales, rotations and opacities besides positions and colour.

questions.q: Why does SplatToMesh need Otsu's method?
options: A splat has no surface, so the node must choose which density level counts as one
questions.answer: A splat has no surface, so the node must choose which density level counts as one
questions.why: _otsu_level picks a split between empty and occupied density. level scales it.

questions.q: A splat-to-mesh result has holes. What should you try?
options: Raise kernel or lower level, so sparse blobs reach each other
questions.answer: Raise kernel or lower level, so sparse blobs reach each other
questions.why: The lab shows many rays missing the surface with small blobs. min_component and min_opacity remove material and make holes worse.

questions.q: How many floats does one Gaussian hold at spherical-harmonic degree 0?
questions.why: Centre 3, scale 3, rotation 4, opacity 1, colour 3. Degree 3 has 48 colour values, giving 59.

options: Colour only: it biases each voxel towards its strongest blob
questions.answer: Colour only: it biases each voxel towards its strongest blob
questions.why: Its tooltip says colour only, geometry unchanged. _splat_density weights colour by w to that power.
